title: My Trading Bot result . Optimized for MNQ and NQ, the result is for NQ,
author: Typical-Magician605
selftext: It includes a 1 tick slippage on all trades and $5 all in per side per contract. Trades 2 contracts and Max daily loss is defined.

comments.author: joshman1204
comments.body: Another bot on a paper account. Unless it's a live account with real money nobody cares. You and every other guy with a Claude sub has a bot running on paper. Its means exactly nothing.

replies.author: Typical-Magician605
replies.body: To come up with the a working strategy with positive expectancy, back tested for multiple years is not easy. I have bunch of strategies that have 80-90 % win rate and multiple profit factors , but can only go back about 90 days or less, once it is tested for multiple years it generally is a coin toss.
